pipeline_name: China-Russia Binhai-Jilin Overseas Landing  Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: No edit needed to Status/Length/Location. Monitor P3895 (the Heilongjiang/Hulin Far-East crossing) as the apparent successor route -- if a future sweep confirms it has formally absorbed this project's role, P4559 may warrant ShelvedCancelledType promotion to a dated 'cancelled', but that is not sourced yet.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed via a real, independently-found primary source -- Jilin Provincial Government's own 14th Five-Year Plan (2021-03, hosted at ndrc.gov.cn), which names this EXACT project ('中俄滨海－吉林海外天然气登陆通道') with an exact-match investment figure, route description and length (80 km China-domestic section) that all agree with the sheet. gem.wiki's own page for P4559 carries ZERO harvested citations (verified against wiki_citations.json) -- this project's wiki prose clearly draws from this same NDRC document (the wording is a close paraphrase) but was never formally cited on the page, which is exactly the pattern that makes an entity LOOK like a possible hallucination until traced independently. It is not one -- this is a real (if apparently dormant) provincial planning-stage proposal, not a GEM-only or fabricated entity. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission both correctly describe an international border-to-city-gate trunk line; no reclassification needed. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 32-row roster -- P3895 (Dalnerechensk->Heilongjiang, the OTHER Far-East China crossing option, via Hulin) is geographically and administratively distinct (different province, different border town, different crossing) and is NOT the same physical pipe as P4559; no duplicate found. CAVEAT (why not a clean 'confirmed' with no note): this row is single-sourced -- only the one 2021 planning document names this specific project anywhere found (English, Chinese and Russian search); every fill on this row is tier=medium for that reason. Also notable: Jilin's OWN successor 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030, verified live) drops this project entirely and instead lists a Hulin(Heilongjiang)-Changchun gas pipeline with a Yanji branch as the route for importing Russian Far-East gas -- i.e. Jilin's own government appears to have redirected its cross-border gas-import plan away from the Hunchun/Binhai option toward the Heilongjiang crossing (P3895's corridor) sometime between 2021 and 2026. That is consistent with -- and reinforces -- the current 'shelved' classification, though nothing found formally announces this project as cancelled or superseded, so I am not proposing that change on this pass.

This is a verbatim, exact-name match to the row's pipeline_name/segment_name.

fills.researcher_notes: gem.wiki page for P4559 carries 0 harvested citations (wiki_citations.json confirms) -- this row was sourced ENTIRELY from an independent search of Chinese-language primary sources, never via gem.wiki's own citation list. Re-opened the cited NDRC-hosted PDF (Jilin Province's official 14th Five-Year Plan, 2021-03). It is a real, primary, non-GEM document that NAMES this exact project and describes it under the plan's '专栏39 重点油气项目' (Box 39: Key Oil & Gas Projects) list, introduced by the sentence '谋划推进海外天然气登陆通道建设' ("planning to advance construction of the overseas gas landing corridor") -- i.e. the document itself frames this as a PROPOSAL, never states it was built or even approved for construction. Searched broadly (English + Chinese + Russian) for ANY evidence of progress after March 2021 -- CNPC/PipeChina project pages, Jilin/Yanbian/Hunchun government sites, Chinese trade press, NDRC/provincial DRC filings, environmental-review registries, Russian-language coverage of Hunchun-Kraskino energy activity -- and found NONE. The only Hunchun-Russia gas activity independently confirmed in that window is truck-borne LNG imports starting Dec 2021 (RIA Novosti), not a pipeline. Jilin's OWN successor plan -- the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030, https://xxgk.jl.gov.cn/szf/gkml/202604/W020260414342541726620.pdf, verified) -- does NOT mention this project at all; its gas-pipeline project list instead names a '虎林－长春天然气管道延吉支线' (Hulin-Changchun gas pipeline, Yanji branch) -- i.e. Jilin's own next plan routes Russian Far-East gas in via the HEILONGJIANG/Hulin crossing (P3895's corridor), not via Hunchun. That is strong corroborating evidence this project was quietly dropped in favor of the Heilongjiang route, never formally announced as cancelled. Applying the dormancy rule (proposed 2021, zero progress, >2y elapsed) confirms 'shelved' is the right classification; nothing found pushes it to 'cancelled' with any confidence (see status_reviews for ShelvedYear/ShelvedCancelledType). Single-source for the project's own facts (only the 2021 plan document names it) -- searched extensively (see above) for a second corroborating source describing THIS specific project and found none; tier held at medium accordingly.

cross_row_leads.facts: Jilin's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030, Jilin Provincial Government, verified live) lists a '虎林－长春天然气管道延吉支线' (Hulin-Changchun gas pipeline, Yanji branch) among its gas-pipeline projects to implement -- i.e. Jilin's own current plan routes Russian Far-East gas into the province via the Hulin (Heilongjiang) border crossing, P3895's corridor, with an extension toward Yanji/the Jilin heartland, rather than via the Hunchun/Binhai option (P4559).
